records.issue_text: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:2 — Validation limits top-level domains to five letters, rejecting previously supported valid hosts such as example.technology.
records.rationale: The diff shows in app/models/embeddable_host.rb line 2 a regex validation: `validates_format_of :host, :with => /\A[a-z0-9]+([\-\.]{1}[a-z0-9]+)*\.[a-z]{2,5}(:[0-9]{1,5})?(\/.*)?\Z/i`. The `[a-z]{2,5}` part limits TLDs to 2-5 characters. Valid TLDs like .museum (6 chars) or .technology (10 chars) would be rejected by this regex. This is a real bug that restricts valid hosts that could have been used with the previous site setting approach.
